clause: Interop model steerability + headless/quiet + manual + validation obligation [STU-IO-014]

scope.summary: Enforce the interop cross-cutting obligation: every StudioImportProfile and StudioExportRecipe action is a typed model-steerable command with a stable identifier, observable through Argus (14.16), and runs headless + quiet under 14.20 (no foreground window, no focus steal, bounded + observable) so batch import/export is safe for parallel operator/model co-work. Each format row and export surface carries a dual-audience UserManual entry (14.22) stating compatibility scope, fixtures, round-trip envelope, unsupported-feature receipts, and recovery behavior. A model-authored import/export changing document authority MUST pass sandbox -> StudioValidationDescriptor -> PromotionGate ([STU-ARC-005]); the fixture/receipt gate of [STU-IO-004] is part of that validation and is NOT optional regardless of model confidence.
acceptance_criteria: all interop ops model-steerable + Argus-observable + headless/quiet + manual-covered + promotion+fixture/receipt-gated
proof_targets: manual coverage + fail-closed promotion (fixture/receipt gate) + quiet-headless audit
expected_tests: HBR-MAN-003: every studio import/export command_id has a manual entry stating scope/fixtures/round-trip/receipts/recovery
negative: model-authored interop write blocked from direct authority write (fails closed via PromotionGate incl. fixture/receipt gate)
argus+quiet: batch import/export observable headless with no focus steal

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

risk_if_missed: Ungated/unobservable/undocumented interop commands; model interop bypasses fixture/receipt validation.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
